rate_table_note: Rates are from Table 2 of the bulletin, page 5 (12 months) and page 6 (60 months). Old rates not recorded: the previous bulletin (2019-018) is a scanned image with no text and was not imported.
summary: Bulletin 2021-0028 reduced the credit accident and health prima facie rates by 10%, effective February 1, 2022, because credit accident and health loss ratios did not reach 90% of the rule's loss ratio. It rescinded and replaced Bulletin 2021-025 of November 17, 2021, which had set a January 1, 2022 effective date. Headline rates are the 12- and 60-month single premium rates.
legal_basis: 13.18.2.44 and 13.18.2.45 NMAC (as in effect 2021); NMSA 1978, Sections 59A-2-8 and 59A-2-10
